title: The 'Where should it go?' folder sheet is never tested empty, closed, or for a copy
what: The folder sheet's row order is checked as data, and one phone test picks 'My routines' from it. No test opens it for a brand-new member with no folders, closes it without picking, or makes a copy from a routine's page, so an empty sheet, a folder made by closing it, or a copy made before a folder is picked would pass.
expected: Tests that open the sheet with no folders (one 'My routines' row), close it (nothing made), and copy a routine into the followed plan with the original left in place.
fix_line: Add tests for the sheet with no folders, closed without a pick, and the copy path

title: What sets off the forgotten-workout pause is never tested, including the hold timer
what: The pause rule itself is well tested as sums. What starts the check is not: no test returns the app from the background and waits for the one check about 3 seconds later, checks there is no pause while the app is in the background, or reads ticks from the notification shade first. No test opens a hold timer and checks the workout is not paused during a timed set, or still pauses when the timer was never started, which is the known bug of a timer left open blocking the pause.
expected: Tests that drive the check from the app coming back, from the background, and with the hold timer open before and after Start.
fix_line: Add tests that run the pause check from the app's return, the background and an open hold timer

title: Ticking a set from the workout card or the watch is never tested end to end
what: The words on the ongoing card and the watch lines are checked. No test presses 'Complete set' on the card or Done on the watch and then checks the phone's workout has that one set ticked with the same numbers and the rest started, or that the card goes away after Finish or a discard and the watch says 'Workout saved' only after Finish.
expected: A test that ticks from the card and from the watch and reads the workout back, and one that finishes and discards with the card up.
fix_line: Add a test that ticks a set from the card and the watch and checks the workout

title: The record pop-up, its sound and the medal are never seen in a test
what: Which sets count as records is tested well as rules. No test shows the pop-up for a heavier set, plays or skips the record sound, puts the medal on the set number, removes the medal when the set is unticked, or checks that a set that only beat last time gets a quiet line with no sound.
expected: A screen test of a workout with a record set, an unticked record set and a beat-last-time set.
fix_line: Add a screen test for the record pop-up, sound and medal

title: The one-time time repair failing half-way, and start-up not waiting for it, are never tested
what: The repair of old imported times is tested when it works. No test makes it fail part-way to check either every workout moved or none and that the done mark is not set over unmoved workouts, and none checks the app opens without waiting for it. A half-done repair would move some workouts and then never run again.
expected: A test that breaks the repair mid-way and checks nothing moved and it runs again next start, and one that the app opens first.
fix_line: Add a test where the repair fails half-way and is retried

title: Back after Finish, the summary shown twice and first-workout records are never tested
what: The finish screen's numbers and lines are tested as data and a phone test reaches 'Workout complete'. No test presses Back after Finish to check the workout does not open again as still running, checks the summary is shown once, that paused time is left out of the minutes on the summary line, or that a first workout's lifts are not all called new records. The 'Done returns to the Workout tab' step is pressed but where it lands is not checked.
expected: A phone test that finishes, presses Back, and checks the Workout tab with no open workout; data tests for paused minutes and first-workout records.
fix_line: Add a test for Back after Finish and for paused minutes on the summary

title: No test checks History shows only the member's own workouts, never the demo's
what: History paging and search are tested on a phone database holding only the member's own workouts. No test loads the demo or a gym's sample data and checks they stay out of the Workouts feed and its month counts.
expected: A test with demo workouts present that checks the feed and counts hold only the member's own.
fix_line: Add a History test with the demo loaded

title: Saving a PNG or HEIC progress photo, and photos never leaving the phone, are never tested
what: The one phone test saves a sample JPEG to the share list. No test hands over a PNG or HEIC photo as its own picture type, and no test checks that saving or viewing a progress photo sends nothing to MettleUp or the gym.
expected: A test with a PNG and a HEIC photo, and a check that no network call carries a progress photo.
fix_line: Add tests for other photo types and for photos staying on the phone
